## Downloads

- **KCap-windows-x64-setup.exe**: Windows x64 installer.
- **KCap-windows-x64-portable.zip**: Extract and run `kcap.exe` without installing.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: SHA-256 checksums for both downloads.

Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. The installer can install WebView2 when needed. Portable users need WebView2 already installed.

## Features

Region capture, multiple floating screenshot windows, clipboard copy, PNG saving, arrow/rectangle/pen annotations, global shortcut, and a system tray icon.

This build is not code-signed, so Windows may display an unknown publisher warning.
